responsibility: Declares the Unix argument access interface for the boot runtime, exporting routines to retrieve the saved process argument count, argument vector, and environment vector. It is the low-level process-startup companion to the higher-level `Args` and `SArgs` wrappers.
same_name_distinction: Declares the UnixArgs getters for saved argc/argv/envp values, while gcc/m2/pge-boot/GUnixArgs.cc holds the actual global state and initialization-time capture logic via M2RTS registration.
